login.setupPrompt: Your administrator requires two-factor authentication. Scan this QR code with an authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code.
login.recoveryCodesHint: Each can be used once if you lose your device. They won't be shown again.
login.enterCode: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
login.enterCodeToFinish: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app to finish signing in.
login.changePasswordPrompt: You must set a new password before continuing.
login.trustDeviceInfo: For 30 days, this device will sign you in automatically — no password and no two-factor code. Only use this on a private device you control. You can revoke it anytime from Settings → Account.
login.useAnotherAccount: Sign in with a different account

setup.title: Initial Setup
setup.subtitle: Create your administrator account
setup.cardDescription: This is the first time setup. Create an admin account to get started.

notFound.heading: Page Not Found
notFound.message: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has been moved.

account.languageHint: Applies to your account on every device.
account.passwordTooShort: New password must be at least 6 characters

mfa.title: Two-Factor Authentication (TOTP)
mfa.recoveryHint: Each can be used once if you lose your device. Store them somewhere safe.
mfa.intro: Protect your account with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, Bitwarden...).
mfa.scanPrompt: Scan with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code.
mfa.requiredNote: 2FA is required by an administrator and cannot be disabled.

trustedDevices.title: Trusted devices
trustedDevices.description: Devices that sign in automatically for 30 days without a password or two-factor code.

users.subtitle: Manage webapp users and roles
users.deleteDescription: This user will be permanently deleted.
users.passwordMinError: Password must be at least 6 characters

passwordPolicy.title: Password policy
passwordPolicy.requireComplexityHint: (one uppercase, one lowercase, one digit, one special character)
passwordPolicy.appliedHint: Applied when creating a user, changing your password, and when an admin resets a password.

reverseProxy.title: Reverse proxy / client IP
reverseProxy.description: Number of reverse proxies in front of the backend, so the real client IP is read from X-Forwarded-For (connection journal, rate limiting). 1 = the built-in frontend nginx only; add 1 per extra proxy/WAF (e.g. 2 behind SafeLine).
reverseProxy.detectedIpPre: Detected IP for your current request:
reverseProxy.detectedIpPost: Adjust the hop count and save until this shows your real public IP (save reloads it).

journalRetention.title: Connection journal retention
journalRetention.hint: 0 keeps everything. Applies to Minecraft sessions, refused connections and MC Manager logins.

mapUrl.title: World map
mapUrl.hint: Address of your BlueMap or Dynmap page, loaded by the browser in the Map page. Leave empty to hide the page. MC Manager never contacts it.
mapUrl.failed: Could not save the map address

console.title: Console
console.commandPlaceholder: Type a server command, Tab to complete, Enter to send

hints.selectorSelf: command executor, none from the console

stop.title: Stop the server?
stop.description: Connected players will be disconnected. The world is saved before shutdown.

restart.title: Restart the server?
restart.description: Connected players will be disconnected for about a minute.

confirmRestore.title: Restore {{name}}?
confirmRestore.description: A safety backup is taken first, then the server is stopped, the archive content replaces the current data, and the server is started again. Players will be disconnected.
confirmRestore.noSafety: The server is stopped: no safety backup can be taken. The current data will be overwritten without a safety net.
confirmRestore.confirmNoSafety: I understand, restore without a safety backup

interrupted.title: A restore was interrupted
interrupted.description: The restore of {{archive}} did not finish (the backend stopped or crashed while it was running). The data may be half restored: restore the safety backup, or dismiss this warning once you have handled it.

sheet.noStats: No statistics yet: the server has not written this player's stats file.

config.title: Server configuration
config.missing: server.properties does not exist yet: start the server once to create it.
config.lockedBy: Managed by {{var}} in the container environment. Set OVERRIDE_SERVER_PROPERTIES=false in the Minecraft stack to make this file authoritative.
config.lockedRcon: RCON settings are managed by MC Manager and cannot be edited here.
config.restartRequired: Restart required to apply the saved configuration.
config.restartDescription: Players will be disconnected while the server restarts.
config.lockedHint: Some keys are locked because the container environment sets them at each start. Set OVERRIDE_SERVER_PROPERTIES=false in the Minecraft stack (or remove those variables) to edit them here.

mods.title: Mods

unsupported.title: Mods are not managed for this server
unsupported.description: The Minecraft container must run a modded or plugin server (TYPE=FABRIC, QUILT, FORGE, NEOFORGE, PAPER, ...). Vanilla servers have no mods folder. The list below is read-only.

inline.title: The mod list still lives in your compose file
inline.description: Import it once, then point MODRINTH_PROJECTS to the file managed by MC Manager so that your changes apply at the next restart.

other.title: MODRINTH_PROJECTS points to another listing file
other.description: MC Manager only manages its own file. Point the variable to it so that your changes apply at the next restart.

none.title: MODRINTH_PROJECTS is not set on the container
none.description: Add this line to the environment of the Minecraft container so that the list below is applied at the next restart.

mods.composeLine: Line to add to the container environment
mods.restartRequired: Restart required: the server loads mods at startup only.

add.placeholder: Project slug, e.g. lithium or lithium:0.14.0
add.hint: The slug is the last part of the project URL on modrinth.com.

remove.title: Remove {{entry}} from the list?
remove.description: The image deletes its jar at the next restart. You can add it again later.

manual.title: Manual jars
manual.description: Files dropped by hand in the mods folder; disabled ones are renamed .jar.disabled.
manual.conflict: Both .jar and .jar.disabled exist: remove one on the host.
manual.deleteDescription: The file is removed permanently; nothing is kept.
manual.deleteConflictDescription: Both the .jar and the .jar.disabled copies are removed.

errors.invalid_entry: Invalid entry: use a Modrinth slug, optionally with :version, a loader prefix or a trailing ?.
errors.unknown_project: No Modrinth project with this slug.
errors.wrong_type: This Modrinth project is not a mod (modpack, resource pack or shader).
errors.loader_mismatch: This project has no version for the server loader.
errors.modrinth_unavailable: Modrinth could not be reached. Try again later.
errors.unsupported_server: Mods are not managed for this server type.
errors.busy: Another data operation is running (backup, restore or configuration). Try again in a moment.
errors.conflict: Conflicting state on disk: check the mods folder on the host.
errors.not_found: This mod is no longer listed.
errors.invalid_name: File name not accepted: letters, digits, dots, dashes, spaces and .jar extension only.
errors.too_large: Jar files are limited to 100 MB.
errors.not_a_jar: This file is not a valid jar archive.
errors.wrong_loader: This jar is not a mod for the server loader (detected: {{detected}}).
errors.exists: A file with this name already exists.
errors.managed: This file is managed by Modrinth: remove it from the list instead.
errors.duplicate_mod: This mod is already provided by {{other}}.

unavailable.title: The Minecraft container cannot be reached
unavailable.description: Docker or the container is unavailable, so the server type is unknown. The list below is read-only until the container is back.

search.placeholder: Search Modrinth, or type a slug (lithium, lithium:0.14.0)
search.hint: Press Enter to add a slug directly.

upload.drop: Drop a .jar file here or click to choose
upload.replaceDescription: The existing file is overwritten; the server loads the new one at the next restart.

world.title: World
world.offline: The server must be running to adjust the world.
world.unsupported: This command is not supported by this Minecraft version.

rules.title: Difficulty and game mode
rules.resetOnRestart: Reset at restart by {{var}} in the container environment.

gamerules.title: Game rules
gamerules.legacy: This server predates Minecraft 1.21.11: the old rule names are used.

map.title: World map
map.emptyHint: Add the public address of your BlueMap or Dynmap page in Settings and it will show up here.
